unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 5 - Polish and Publish - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Three pictures held all term: flag (claim), magnifier (prove), megaphone (sell). Weeks 1-5 final piece: a published persuasive text on an issue from The Last Bear.

lessons.title: Feedback Friends
lessons.focus: Give and use feedback against agreed criteria: one glow, one grow, one question. Critical feature: useful feedback points at a sentence and says what to try.

lessons.title: Revise for Impact
lessons.focus: Revise the draft with Add, Remove, Move, Swap and vary sentence length. Critical feature: revising changes the meaning and impact, editing fixes the errors. Retrieves: Term 3 complex sentences.

lessons.title: Edit Like a Pro
lessons.focus: Edit commas after prepositional phrases, apostrophes and spelling; persuasion crossword. Critical feature: read it aloud, slowly, once for each check. Fun activity: crossword. Retrieves: Term 3 prepositional phrases.

lessons.title: Publish Day
lessons.focus: Publish the final piece and share it with a real audience; reflect on growth. Critical feature: a published piece is clean, clear and written for its reader.
